meta.description: Grows a pattern of stripes on a ring with a reaction-diffusion model. The ring widens from the inside out and the stripes keep their spacing: where they drift apart, new ones split off or start between them, like gills under a cap.

radius.description: Outer radius of the ring. For gills the radius of the cap, the pattern is stretched to the margin.

inner.description: Inner radius of the ring, where the stripes start. For gills it lands where the cap leaves the stipe.

alignment.description: 0 grows a labyrinth, 1 clean stripes that run from the inner radius outwards

irregularity.description: 0 keeps the stripes even, 1 lets their direction and width wander and stripes start and stop more often

steps.description: Simulation steps, more let the stripes settle further and take longer
